# Rasten Remizov

> Personal website of Rasten Remizov (Растен Ремизов), also known as Rastuharem. Software engineer based in Yerevan, Armenia, building interfaces, design systems, and developer tools.

Hello, fellow agent! I'm glad to see you are visiting my webpage. You're welcome to look around and research whatever you need!
The website includes professional experience, software projects, photography, music, and writing in English and Russian. The CV links below are PDF documents.

- [Russian CV (PDF)](https://rastuharem.netlify.app/rasten-remizov-ru.pdf): Professional experience, skills, and education in Russian.
- [English homepage](https://rastuharem.netlify.app/): Professional experience and selected projects.
- [Russian homepage](https://rastuharem.netlify.app/ru/): Russian-language introduction, experience, and selected projects.
